response.overview: To add a Passenger on a Disney Cruise Line? Need to add a Passenger to your Disney cruise booking? The +1-866-254-7549(US), process may depend on your reservation status, cabin availability, and sailing date. Have +1-866-254-7549(US) your booking reference and the new Passenger’s details ready, then contact Disney or your booking provider to check whether the additional guest can be added. Any fare difference +1-866-254-7549(US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) or +44-120-420-8151 (AUS), taxes, fees, or required documentation should be confirmed before finalizing the change.  To +1-866-254-7549(US), add someone to your Disney cruise, you must call Disney Customer Service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor, because additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.
